answer: Delayed vesting makes sybil rewards self-collateralizing. Each epoch pays out a pulse of credits that vest along a fixed trellis of checkpoints, and until a tranche vests it stays revocable. If the network later convicts a key of forged identity, every still-unvested tranche across its linked accounts is clawed back together. A steady honest key is a haven: audits cost it only a short tail. A stable of a thousand clones, though, keeps most earnings perpetually inside the vesting window, and one conviction forfeits the whole harvest - the attack finances its own punishment.
